name: Encrypted SQLite
shortDescription: Interact with encrypted SQLite databases using SQLCipher 4

rawRecord.name: Encrypted SQLite
rawRecord.short_description: Interact with encrypted SQLite databases using SQLCipher 4
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides tools to read database structures, query tables, and perform CRUD operations on encrypted SQLite databases. Works with databases from MoneyMoney, KeePass, 1Password, Signal, WhatsApp, Firefox, Telegram, and other applications that use SQLCipher 4 encryption. Supports configurable cipher profiles, parameterized queries, and AES-256-GCM encrypted passphrases.
